        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 6 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_reinvestment multiplier = 0.25 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_reinvestment value = 6 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 7 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_reinvestment multiplier = 0.5 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_reinvestment value = 7 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 8 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_reinvestment multiplier = 1.0 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_reinvestment value = 8 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 9 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_reinvestment multiplier = 5.0 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_reinvestment value = 9 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 10 }
        remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste
        if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 1 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste multiplier = -0.9 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 2 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste multiplier = -0.75 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste value = 2 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 3 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste multiplier = -0.5 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste value = 3 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 4 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste multiplier = -0.25 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste value = 4 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 5 }
            remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 6 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste multiplier = 0.25 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste value = 6 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 7 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste multiplier = 0.5 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste value = 7 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 8 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste multiplier = 1.0 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste value = 8 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 9 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste multiplier = 5.0 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste value = 9 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 11 }
        remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_throughput
        if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 1 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_throughput multiplier = -0.9 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_throughput value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 2 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_throughput multiplier = -0.75 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_throughput value = 2 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 3 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_throughput multiplier = -0.5 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_throughput value = 3 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 4 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_throughput multiplier = -0.25 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_throughput value = 4 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 5 }
            remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_throughput
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 6 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_throughput multiplier = 0.25 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_throughput value = 6 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 7 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_throughput multiplier = 0.5 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_throughput value = 7 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 8 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_throughput multiplier = 1.0 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_throughput value = 8 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_value_index = 9 }
            add_modifier = { name = cmp_economy2_throughput multiplier = 5.0 }
            set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_state_throughput value = 9 }
        }
    }
}

cmp_economy2_reset_selected_on_country_effect = {
    if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 1 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_dividend_efficiency remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_efficiency }
    else_if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 2 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_minting remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_minting }
    else_if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 3 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_construction_cost remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_construction_cost }
    else_if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 4 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_government_wages remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_government_wages }
    else_if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 5 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_military_wages remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_military_wages }
    else_if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 6 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_loan_interest remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_loan_interest }
    else_if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 7 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_consumption_tax_cost remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_consumption_tax_cost }
    else_if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 8 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_private_construction remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_private_construction }
    else_if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 9 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_dividend_reinvestment remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_reinvestment }
    else_if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 10 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste }
    else_if = { limit = { root.var:cmp_economy2_parameter_index = 11 } remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_throughput remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_throughput }
}

    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_efficiency

    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_minting

    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_construction_cost
    remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_government_wages
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_government_wages
    remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_military_wages
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_military_wages
    remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_loan_interest
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_loan_interest
    remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_consumption_tax_cost
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_consumption_tax_cost
    remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_private_construction
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_private_construction
    remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_dividend_reinvestment
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_reinvestment
    remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_dividend_waste
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_dividend_waste
    remove_modifier = cmp_economy2_throughput
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_state_throughput

    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_policy_foreign_collectivization

    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_policy_disable_non_company_privatization

    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_policy_disable_nationalization

    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_policy_disable_uncompensated_nationalization

    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_policy_protect_government_buildings
}

cmp_economy2_apply_selected_effect = {
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_feedback
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = cmp_target_core_mode } var:cmp_target_core_mode = 1 } }
        cmp_economy2_apply_selected_to_country_effect = yes
        set_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target
        set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_feedback value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:cmp_target_core_mode = 2 }
        every_country = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_mark_country_target } cmp_economy2_apply_selected_to_country_effect = yes root = { set_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target } set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_feedback value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_feedback value = -1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:cmp_target_core_mode = 3 }
        every_country = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_target_group_a_member } cmp_economy2_apply_selected_to_country_effect = yes root = { set_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target } set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_feedback value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_feedback value = -1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:cmp_target_core_mode = 4 }
        every_country = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_target_group_b_member } cmp_economy2_apply_selected_to_country_effect = yes root = { set_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target } set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_feedback value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_feedback value = -1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:cmp_target_core_mode = 5 }
        every_country = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_target_group_c_member } cmp_economy2_apply_selected_to_country_effect = yes root = { set_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target } set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_feedback value = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_feedback value = -1 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = cmp_economy2_feedback value = -2 } }
    remove_variable = cmp_economy2_any_target
}
